hero_eyebrow: Expert Vehicle Electrical Repairs — Fast Diagnostics

services_heading: Complete Vehicle Electrical Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From starter motor replacement to full diagnostic testing, we handle every electrical fault your car, van, or HGV might throw at us.

services.title: Battery Replacement & Testing
services.desc: Dead battery ruining your day? We test, supply, and fit quality replacement batteries with warranty. Most jobs completed while you wait.

services.title: Alternator & Starter Motor Repair
services.desc: Struggling to turn over? Dimming lights while driving? We repair or replace faulty alternators and starter motors, keeping your charge system healthy.

services.title: Full Vehicle Electrical Diagnostics
services.desc: Warning lights on the dash? Electrical gremlins draining your battery? We use specialist diagnostic equipment to pinpoint the fault fast.

services.title: Wiring & Loom Repair
services.desc: Corroded or damaged wiring causing intermittent faults? We repair, rewire, or replace looms to restore reliable electrics.

services.title: Auxiliary Equipment Installation
services.desc: Need a reversing camera, dashcam, or additional lighting? We supply and fit specialist equipment with full integration into your vehicle's electrics.

services.title: HGV & Commercial Vehicle Electrics
services.desc: Lorries, vans, and commercial chassis need specialist care. We service 24V systems and heavy-duty electrical equipment.

about_pullquote: We fix cars the right way — honest diagnosis, fair pricing, no surprises.
about_para_1: Peters Auto Electrics has been keeping Liverpool's vehicles on the road for over 18 years. Founded by Peter, a fully trained vehicle electrician, the shop specialises in diagnosing and repairing electrical faults that other garages often overlook or overcharge for. We've built our reputation on getting to the root cause, not just replacing parts.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we're straightforward: we tell you what's wrong, what it'll cost, and how long it'll take. Whether it's a one-minute battery top-up or a full diagnostic on a mystery electrical gremlin, we treat every job with the same care. Based on Britonside Ave, we serve Liverpool and the surrounding Merseyside area with same-day turnaround on most repairs.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Battery completely dead, thought I was looking at a big bill. Peter tested it, fitted a new one, and had me back on the road in 20 minutes. Fair price too — no nonsense. Brilliant service.

reviews.text: Alternator was playing up, another garage wanted to replace the whole lot. Peters diagnosed the fault properly and fixed it for a fraction of the price. Really knew what he was doing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Christine W.

reviews.text: Had strange electrical gremlins draining my battery. They were brilliant at tracking down the fault without charging me a fortune in diagnostics. Quick, professional, and honest. Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: David M.
